purpose: Predeclared SWC-to-Oxc cutover projection for ordinary parser goals shared by both parsers

outcomePolicy.accepted: The parser returned an AST and no parser diagnostics
outcomePolicy.diagnostic: The parser returned an error or any recovered parser diagnostic

spanPolicy.validation: Every projected top-level half-open byte span is ordered, within source bounds, and non-overlapping with the next top-level item
spanPolicy.rationale: The parsers use different source-position bases and recovery spans; cutover equivalence requires valid ordering, not byte-identical internal spans

equivalencePolicy.recoveryRule: Any diagnostic is non-equivalent to acceptance; two diagnostic outcomes are equivalent without fitting message text

excluded: node-specific AST variants below top level
the LLP 0024 hybrid Script-plus-import-plus-TLA adapter, which has a separate oracle
